subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@cloudbridge.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps

Hi Priya / Miguel,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning — really valuable conversation on CloudBridge's marketplace goals and how Redwood can support a lightweight listing + private deployment option for your enterprise customers. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: you want a marketplace listing that supports BYO-models, private deployment for regulated customers, and an integration path for billing via CloudBridge marketplace.
- Open items: technical deep-dive on the private deployment network/topology, confirmation on metrics we expose in the marketplace dashboard, and estimated timelines for a pilot.

Proposed next step: schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive + demo next week with our Solutions Engineer (Alex) so we can walk through network/topology and sample config (VPC peering, KMS/HSM options, and onboarding checklist). Are any of these slots good for you?

- Tue 10/20 10:00-10:45 PT
- Tue 10/20 14:00-14:45 PT
- Wed 10/21 09:00-09:45 PT

I've attached a short integration scope and a draft mutual action plan so we can align on owners and deliverables ahead of the call. If there's anyone else on your side who should join (billing/product/infra), please loop them in.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Partner Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Integration_Scope.pdf; mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Priya Shah <priya@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@cloudbridge.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Miguel and I are aligned on the scope. We can do Tue 10/20 14:00 PT, that works best.

Attendees from our side: Priya (Partner PM), Miguel (Solutions/Cloud). I can also invite a member of our billing team if we need to cover marketplace billing flows — I'll confirm by EOD Monday.

No NDA required at this stage. Looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Priya
Priya Shah
Partnerships Lead | CloudBridge
priya@cloudbridge.com

Hi Priya / Miguel — thanks, confirmed for Tue 10/20 14:00 PT. I've created a calendar event and added a short agenda:

1) 10m - introductions & success criteria
2) 20m - demo of Redwood private deployment + marketplace integration points
3) 10m - security/networking/credentials Q&A
4) 5m - next actions & owners (mutual action plan)

Thanks — Alex
